title: NumPy and pandas: arrays and tabular data

spans.text: NumPy provides homogeneous numeric arrays and vectorized computation. pandas provides labeled tables for filtering, grouping, and summarizing data such as CSV files. They are third-party dependencies; plain Python may be simpler for small inputs.

spans.code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

samples = np.array([20.0, 22.0, 24.0])
readings = pd.DataFrame({'celsius': samples})
print(samples.mean(), readings['celsius'].max())

spans.text: NumPy computes the mean and pandas computes the column maximum, producing

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Install with `python -m pip install numpy pandas` in the active `.venv`. Validate column types, missing values, and numeric ranges when loading data.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Loading a large file fully can exhaust RAM; use chunking and suitable dtypes, then validate results on a small sample.
